svg.title: Fuzzy fraud risk
svg.desc: Fuzzy membership functions: 3 variables (amount, velocity, risk) and 4 rules.
svg.text: Mamdani system: amount and velocity give risk

g.class: mk s0s0 fz pv0 s0 u3
g.aria-label: low, Trapezoidal(0, 0, 300, 1200), Peak membership 1 at 154.5, Used by 1 rule
g.title: low, Trapezoidal(0, 0, 300, 1200), Peak membership 1 at 154.5, Used by 1 rule

g.class: mk s0s1 fz pv0 s1 u1
g.aria-label: medium, Triangular(500, 1800, 3200), Peak membership 1 at 1800, Used by 1 rule
g.title: medium, Triangular(500, 1800, 3200), Peak membership 1 at 1800, Used by 1 rule

g.class: mk s0s2 fz pv0 s2 u0 u2
g.aria-label: high, Trapezoidal(2400, 3600, 5000, 5000), Peak membership 1 at 4297, Used by 2 rules
g.title: high, Trapezoidal(2400, 3600, 5000, 5000), Peak membership 1 at 4297, Used by 2 rules

g.class: mk s1s0 fz pv1 s0 u3
g.aria-label: slow, Gaussian(2, 2), Peak membership 1 at 2, Used by 1 rule
g.title: slow, Gaussian(2, 2), Peak membership 1 at 2, Used by 1 rule

g.class: mk s1s1 fz pv1 s1 u1 u2
g.aria-label: normal, Gaussian(8, 2.5), Peak membership 1 at 8, Used by 2 rules
g.title: normal, Gaussian(8, 2.5), Peak membership 1 at 8, Used by 2 rules

g.class: mk s1s2 fz pv1 s2 u0
g.aria-label: fast, Sigmoid(0.9, 12.5), Peak membership 1 at 11.35, Used by 1 rule
g.title: fast, Sigmoid(0.9, 12.5), Peak membership 1 at 11.35, Used by 1 rule

g.class: mk s2s0 fz pv2 s0 u3
g.aria-label: low, Triangular(0, 15, 40), Peak membership 1 at 15, Used by 1 rule
g.title: low, Triangular(0, 15, 40), Peak membership 1 at 15, Used by 1 rule

g.class: mk s2s1 fz pv2 s1 u1 u2
g.aria-label: medium, Triangular(25, 50, 75), Peak membership 1 at 50, Used by 2 rules
g.title: medium, Triangular(25, 50, 75), Peak membership 1 at 50, Used by 2 rules

g.class: mk s2s2 fz pv2 s2 u0
g.aria-label: high, Triangular(60, 85, 100), Peak membership 1 at 85, Used by 1 rule
g.title: high, Triangular(60, 85, 100), Peak membership 1 at 85, Used by 1 rule

g.aria-label: Rule 1, IF amount is high AND velocity is fast, THEN risk is high
g.title: Rule 1, IF amount is high AND velocity is fast, THEN risk is high
g.text: IF amount is high AND velocity is fast THEN risk is high

g.aria-label: Rule 2, weight 0.8, IF amount is medium AND velocity is normal, THEN risk is medium
g.title: Rule 2, weight 0.8, IF amount is medium AND velocity is normal, THEN risk is medium
g.text: IF amount is medium AND velocity is normal THEN risk is medium (weight 0.8)

g.aria-label: Rule 3, IF amount is high OR velocity is normal, THEN risk is medium
g.title: Rule 3, IF amount is high OR velocity is normal, THEN risk is medium
g.text: IF amount is high OR velocity is normal THEN risk is medium

g.aria-label: Rule 4, IF amount is low AND velocity is slow, THEN risk is low
g.title: Rule 4, IF amount is low AND velocity is slow, THEN risk is low
g.text: IF amount is low AND velocity is slow THEN risk is low
IF amount is high AND velocity is fast
IF amount is medium AND velocity is normal

IF amount is low AND velocity is slow
